status_summary: H.R. 1125, the LOCAL Act, was introduced in the House on 2025-02-07 and referred to the Committee on Natural Resources; the sponsor's release says it would move the BLM headquarters to Grand Junction, Colorado. Local reporting on 2025-04-30 described no further action on the bill. No Secretary's order, announcement or Federal Register notice moving the headquarters was found through October 2026.
